description: This file implements a channel event sink for Mozilla's networking component, monitoring channel redirects, and manages registration/unregistration of this component within the Mozilla platform's component registry.

classes.name: ChannelEventSink
classes.description: An implementation of nsIChannelEventSink that monitors channel redirects and manages a set of collectors.

methods.name: registerCollector
methods.description: Adds a collector to the set of collectors to be notified on channel redirects.

methods.name: unregisterCollector
methods.description: Removes a collector from the set; unregisters the factory if no collectors remain.

methods.name: asyncOnChannelRedirect
methods.description: Handles the channel redirect event, notifying all collectors and invoking the callback.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the ChannelEventSink factory as a component in the component registry.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the ChannelEventSink factory from the component registry.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Ensures registration and retrieves the channel event sink service.
